target_surface: Authenticated Ampere warehouse scan station at https://bol-ampere-scanning.vercel.app/

included_pages: Current read-only aggregate ampere_package_state and ampere_scan_events evidence
Current production index.html bytes and login-gate browser state

Non-ampere Turso tables and unrelated Bankhoes warehouse data

active_rules: Station and Operator recall is convenience metadata only; the warehouse password remains mandatory after authentication expiry and is never stored or returned.
Failed logout retains the auth cookie and logout-pending retry path until database revocation succeeds.
Bol remains source of truth for the active shipment list and cancellation state.
Turso stores only ampere_* scanner auth, audit, and operational state.
Counts use package grain; open orders without labels remain a separate metric.
Accepted or cancelled status remains durable across refresh and the automatic rollover while the package remains in the active bol window.
FIFO, Enter termination, automatic refocus, fail-closed verification, and same-origin browser APIs remain unchanged.
Current desktop/mobile inspection and exact-artifact visual receipt are required after the latest change.
tool_surfaces: approved Bankhoes Turso ampere_* aggregate reads
write_targets: migrations/*.sql if additive schema is required
external_account_policy: Use only accounts explicitly approved in project AGENTS.md; do not retrieve, expose, or persist secrets.
content_truth_policy: Metrics state their package/order grain; remembered labels never imply authentication; persisted scan decisions reflect authoritative server state.

verified: The production index.html is byte-identical to the current repository index.html before this change.
The state key changes at exactly 16:00 Amsterdam and the browser refreshes every five minutes.
Live ampere_* rows remain persisted after they disappear from the selected workday.
The current summary adds order count to shipment count and therefore mixes grains.
The current browser source-account normalizer rejects dynamic acct_* keys.
The warehouse password is already represented only by a server-side scrypt hash and an HttpOnly authenticated session cookie.
inferred: The client's reported delayed reset is the observed 16:00 workday rollover followed by automatic refresh.
unknown: Whether an authenticated production warehouse session will be available for a live post-deploy scan-free visual inspection.
